t: About Us - Young Israel of Century City
s: After months of searching, a building was procured on Pico Boulevard, and by Rosh Hashanah 1982, the Young Israel of Century City had settled into its present location. In January 1986, with about fifty families associated with the Shul, YICC elected its first full-time Rabbi, Elazar Muskin.
